name: CDU Fee-Free TAFE (NT)
summary: Tuition-free CDU TAFE places for people 15 and over who live or work in the Northern Territory and are new to the course.
key: Tuition-free training places to students wanting to train, retrain or upskill.
who: Live or work in the Northern Territory
Australian citizen, permanent resident, eligible NZ citizen or eligible visa holder
At least 15 and not at secondary school
Enrolling in the course for the first time
catches: Applications for 2026 are closed; 2027 courses are listed as coming soon.
